using ACadSharp;
using ACadSharp.Entities;
using ACadSharp.Tables;
using ACadSharp.IO;
using CSMath;
using System.Text;
Encoding.RegisterProvider(CodePagesEncodingProvider.Instance);
var doc=new CadDocument();
doc.Header.Version=ACadVersion.AC1027;
var table=new TableEntity(new BlockRecord("*T1")) {
 InsertPoint=new XYZ(100,200,0), XScale=2,YScale=3,Rotation=Math.PI/6,
 HorizontalDirection=XYZ.AxisX, Style=ACadSharp.Objects.TableStyle.Default
};
for(int c=0;c<2;c++)table.Columns.Add(new TableEntity.Column{Width=20+c*10});
for(int r=0;r<2;r++) {
 var row=new TableEntity.Row{Height=10};
 for(int c=0;c<2;c++) {
  var cell=new TableEntity.Cell();
  var content=new TableEntity.CellContent {ContentType=TableEntity.TableCellContentType.Value};
  content.CadValue.SetValue($"R{r+1} C{c+1}",CadValueType.String);
  cell.Contents.Add(content);row.Cells.Add(cell);
 }
 table.Rows.Add(row);
}
table.MergedCellRanges.Add(new TableEntity.CellRange{TopRowIndex=0,BottomRowIndex=0,LeftColumnIndex=0,RightColumnIndex=1});
doc.Entities.Add(table);
doc.Entities.Add(new Line(new XYZ(0,0,0),new XYZ(5,5,0)));
DwgWriter.Write(args[0],doc,notification:(s,e)=>Console.WriteLine(e.Message));
Console.WriteLine("Wrote: "+args[0]);
var read=DwgReader.Read(args[0]);
foreach(var e in read.Entities)Console.WriteLine(e.ObjectName);
